Role

We are looking for a Principal Peering Coordinator to join our team. This is a Remote (nearby international airports) role, reporting to the VP, Infrastructure Ecosystems & Network in the Zero Trust Exchange department. The core purpose of this role is to manage and build Zscaler’s peering relationships for our global Zero Trust Platform, including public and private exchanges as well as private network interconnections.   • Extensive knowledge of general practices of Public Internet Exchanges and Private Peering
  • Expertise in identifying strategic peering partners in new and existing locations via data and industry knowledge

  • Minimum 8 years of experience in peering networks at common exchange points

The Pricing Strategy team owns the end-to-end pricing, packaging, and commercialization strategy across GitLab's product portfolio, from Premium and Ultimate tiers to GitLab Duo and our expanding artificial intelligence (AI) capabilities. The Pricing Strategy team shapes how GitLab packages, prices, and commercializes its product portfolio.
